description.summary: Tools for the PAM configuration common to all services
description.p: pam-auth-update writes the files /etc/pam.d/common-*, which the PAM configuration of every service includes, from profiles that packages with a PAM module bring along. It is a rewrite in shell of the program of the same name in Debian. pam-securetty restricts logins of root to the consoles of the machine.
